knowledge:
- key_parameters: group=The metadata column name used to group samples (e.g., "study" or patient ID) when constructing the motif matrix ;; normalize=Logical value in motifMatrix; if TRUE, returns motif frequencies instead of raw counts ;; decomposition=The decomposition method function (e.g., nmfDecomposition or pcaDecomposition) passed to identifySignatures or assessNumberSignatures ;; nReplicates=Number of runs for randomly seeded decomposition methods (like NMF) in assessNumberSignatures to calculate average goodness-of-fit statistics
- alternatives: WTSI Mutational Signature Framework (Matlab-based NMF approach) ;; EMu (probabilistic framework based on Poisson processes and Expectation-Maximization)
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have somatic SNV calls across multiple samples or cohorts and want to identify the underlying mutational processes (signatures) and their relative contributions to each sample.
- pitfalls: Technical batch effects (e.g., different sequencing centers or technologies) can confound signatures; use ComBat or similar methods to adjust the motif matrix before decomposition ;; Differences in genomic target regions (e.g., WES vs WGS) alter background k-mer frequencies; use normalizeMotifs to adjust motif frequencies before comparing datasets ;; NMF can be computationally expensive for very large datasets; PCA is a faster alternative though it allows negative values (depletion of motifs).

workflows.name: somatic_signature_extraction
workflows.intent: Extract and analyze somatic mutational signatures from somatic SNV calls and a reference genome.
input: reference_genome.fa (Reference genome sequence or a BSgenome object)
workflows.stages: 1. Import somatic variants into a VRanges object ;; 2. Extract the trinucleotide sequence context of each variant using mutationContext ;; 3. Construct a normalized motif matrix grouped by sample or study using motifMatrix ;; 4. Assess the optimal number of signatures using assessNumberSignatures ;; 5. Identify mutational signatures using identifySignatures with NMF or PCA ;; 6. Visualize the signatures, sample contributions, and spectrum fits using plotting functions ;; 7. Cluster the mutational spectrum by motif or sample using clusterSpectrum.
workflows.code:
library(SomaticSignatures)
library(VariantAnnotation)

vr = VRanges(
    seqnames = "chr1",
    ranges = IRanges(start = 1000, width = 1),
    ref = "A",
    alt = "C")

sca_motifs = mutationContext(sca_vr, BSgenome.Hsapiens.1000genomes.hs37d5)

sca_mm = motifMatrix(sca_motifs, group = "study", normalize = TRUE)

plotMutationSpectrum(sca_motifs, "study")

n_sigs = 5

sigs_nmf = identifySignatures(sca_mm, n_sigs, nmfDecomposition)

sigs_pca = identifySignatures(sca_mm, n_sigs, pcaDecomposition)

n_sigs = 2:8

gof_nmf = assessNumberSignatures(sca_mm, n_sigs, nReplicates = 5)

gof_pca = assessNumberSignatures(sca_mm, n_sigs, pcaDecomposition)

plotNumberSignatures(gof_nmf)

plotNumberSignatures(gof_pca)

plotSignatureMap(sigs_nmf) + ggtitle("Somatic Signatures: NMF - Heatmap")

plotSignatures(sigs_nmf) + ggtitle("Somatic Signatures: NMF - Barchart")

plotObservedSpectrum(sigs_nmf)

plotFittedSpectrum(sigs_nmf)

plotSampleMap(sigs_nmf)

plotSamples(sigs_nmf)

clu_motif = clusterSpectrum(sca_mm, "motif")

workflows.name: signature_normalization_and_batch_correction
workflows.intent: Correct the somatic motif matrix for technical batch effects and normalize for differences in genomic target k-mer frequencies.
input: target_regions.bed (Exome capture or targeted sequencing genomic intervals)
workflows.stages: 1. Correct for technical batch effects in the motif matrix using ComBat ;; 2. Calculate background k-mer frequencies for the reference genome and target regions using kmerFrequency ;; 3. Normalize the motif matrix using normalizeMotifs to adjust for target region sequence composition.
workflows.code:
library(sva)
library(SomaticSignatures)

sca_anno = as.data.frame(lapply(sca_metadata, unlist))

model_null = model.matrix(~ 1, sca_anno)

sca_mm_batch = ComBat(sca_mm, batch = sca_anno$Sequence_Source, mod = model_null)

k = 3
n = 1e4

hs_chrs = as(seqinfo(BSgenome.Hsapiens.1000genomes.hs37d5), "GRanges")
hs_chrs = keepSeqlevels(hs_chrs, c(1:22, "X", "Y"), pruning.mode = "coarse")

k3_hs_chrs = kmerFrequency(BSgenome.Hsapiens.1000genomes.hs37d5, n, k, hs_chrs)

data(kmers)
norms = k3wg / k3we

sca_mm_norm = normalizeMotifs(sca_mm, norms)
